title: Warp metric plate
description: Typed tag, mono title and lead over an ink-framed figure plate: a white card with a tiny bracketed caption row and three metric columns split by hairlines. Each column has a small uppercase label with a boxed badge, a light geometric subtitle, a big mono figure, a chart slot and a short ruled log of rows (label, pass or struck-through fail, value). Phones stack the columns.
notes: each column's chart is a media slot (a plain placeholder strip while empty)
